analysis.purpose: A unified read model that presents the deterministic extracted graph and the agent-authored semantic graph as one composite view, tagging every node and edge with the layer it came from.
responsibilities: Merge extracted, semantic and memory layers into one read surface
Stamp every composite node/edge with its origin layer
Report semantic diagnostics: how many artifacts are fresh, stale or orphaned

businessRules.rule: Every composite node and edge carries an explicit origin, so a consumer can always tell extracted fact from authored interpretation.
businessRules.rationale: Provenance is what keeps authored prose from being mistaken for parsed fact.

nodes.name: Layered graph read
nodes.summary: One view over extracted + semantic layers with provenance.

edges.rationale: This file defines the composite read model.

evidence.why: The composite node type is what carries the origin tag.
Edges are likewise presented as composite, origin-tagged records.
